correctness.rationale: PASS: SVD conjugation by alternating left/right singular-vector unitaries turns every T or T* edge into the same diagonal singular-value matrix, making the path a direct sum of scaled scalar Jordan shifts. Phase rotation gives theta-independent real-part eigenvalues consisting of singular values times all m cosine eigenvalues. The Li–Sze half-plane theorem yields exactly the stated disks or empty sets, including zeros and negative thresholds. A counting induction recovers each next singular value from the first K ordered positive products, with ties and zeros handled by multiplicities. Diagonal inputs whose last singular values are two different positive numbers below the smallest observed cosine product prove K-1 insufficient. The standalone check passed 268 finite tests, supplementary to proof.
